snippet.title: Die Deep Teaser v2.1 - June 2025
snippet.description:
Hi all, this is our new game, Die Deep.
This is the Teaser verion 2, update at June 2025.
Please follow us and keep an eye on the game's development.
Take a look and add it to your wishlist now!
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3211560/

大家好，這是我們的新遊戲 《Die Deep》。
這是一個前期預告片 v2 (更新於2025年6月)
請關注我們，並隨時關注遊戲的開發進度。
現在就來看看並加入願望清單吧！
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3211560/
